kitDescription: Neve is a Water shotgun Burst-III attacker whose kit is entirely self-contained. On a 10-second internal cooldown she automatically fires a bonus hit at the enemy with the lowest remaining HP for 145.45% of her final ATK. Every time the team enters Full Burst she gains Pierce and a 124.8% ATK buff, each lasting for her next 2 shots. Her own burst is a pure self-buff: for 20 seconds after casting she gains 31.95% Critical Rate and 22.04% Hit Rate, the latter sharpening her shotgun pellet grouping onto the boss core. She deals no burst-cast damage of her own.

redAssertions: Blind line 353: others(hitRateZero).toEqual(others(base)) — asserts perfect teammate-total isolation when neve's SELF hitRatePct is zeroed. FALSE-RED: the engine's deterministic EV path couples SG hitRate->core-geometry into teammate totals by <0.5% (neve base 219.3M / hrZero 202.7M; critZero's others() passes, isolating the coupling to the SG-core path). The buff itself is proven self-only by two independent pins (blind 'both buffs are self-only' PASSED; driver N6 targetIdx===NEVE PASSED). This is a blind over-assertion / engine EV artifact, not a driver divergence.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: all 5 load-bearing kit lines are FAITHFUL (4) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (1 — the gainPierce round-count window, a missing schema primitive flagged ⚑ with a recipe and proven damage-inert byte-identically). The driver's encoding is at least as faithful as both blind re-derivations on every line and strictly more faithful on S1 (correct {kind:'enemy'} target where S6 mis-scoped self — a blind RECON_ERROR, damage-neutral). The single RED in the S5-vs-driver run is a classified FALSE-RED: a blind over-assertion of perfect teammate isolation against the engine's deterministic-EV SG-core-geometry coupling (<0.5%), with the buff's self-only scope independently proven by two passing pins — not a divergence. Discrimination holds on every named nearest-wrong model: level-1 S1 magnitude, passive S1 trigger, seconds-for-rounds S2 duration, burstCast S2 re-key, whole-fight hasPierce shape (via the S5 shape pin, which the driver's own N4 inertness test does not by itself discriminate — acceptable since the blind suite covers it), fullBurstEnter burst re-key, and normal-scoped crit. Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check: (a) the S1 interval first-fire phase (t=10) is a standing ⚑ engine convention, never popup-verified for this unit; (b) the gainPierce 2s estimate is unmeasured (recipe recorded); (c) the <0.5% EV teammate-coupling artifact that produced the false-red is worth an owner note as a known test-design trap for future SG hitRate kits, but it is engine-side and out of scope for this unit's GO.
